task.title: Harden dev single-VM and staging dual-VM compose contract
task.summary_zh: 把 dev single-VM 與 staging dual-VM compose contract 收斂成程式碼可驗證狀態：default compose 明確作為 dev baseline；staging VM1 control compose 與 VM2 exec compose 用 env/examples/docs 明確連線並消除 governance/control surface 矛盾。
acceptance: default compose is labelled and verified as dev single-VM baseline
control compose excludes execution and broker secrets while including or explicitly fencing required control-plane services
exec compose excludes BFF and control-plane services while hosting runtime-manager broker adapter exchange adapter and paper runtime
control env example wires runtime-manager to VM2 internal URL without storing broker secrets
topology docs and compose comments no longer contradict governance or runtime placement
compose config and split-topology verification script pass

handoffs.message: Ready for review: labelled root compose as dev single-VM baseline; hardened VM1 control compose with governance/deployment surfaces and VM2 runtime-manager URLs without broker secrets; wired VM2 exec telemetry back to VM1; documented topology; added scripts/validate_split_topology.sh. Verification: docker compose config --quiet passed for root/control/exec, bash -n scripts/validate_split_topology.sh passed, bash scripts/validate_split_topology.sh passed.
